units.name: DrawObjects
units.summary: Draw all 16 object slots into OAM, in ascending order on even frames and descending order on odd frames so overlapping sprites flicker instead of vanishing.

units.name: DrawObject
units.summary: Draw object X. Objects with ObjFlags bit 4 are positioned relative to the camera (ObjScreenX/Y); others use ObjX/ObjY directly as screen coordinates. Objects off screen lose ObjFlags bit 7; players falling below the level enter action 10 (life lost) and other objects more than $60 pixels off screen are removed unless they are persistent types ($4B, $60, metasprite $25).

units.name: DrawObject_Visible
units.summary: On screen: advance the animation and emit sprites. Invincible players blink (skipped every other 4 frames). Animation format (AnimPtrLo/Hi by ObjAnim): byte 0 = number of frames (bit 7 selects the second metasprite bank), byte 1 = frame duration, then one metasprite id per frame. ObjAnimFrame counts the duration, ObjAnimTimer is the frame index.

units.name: DrawObject_Emit
units.summary: Metasprite: byte 0 = sprite count-1, byte 1 = layout id (+1 when facing right), then tile/attribute pairs. The layout (LayoutPtrLo/Hi) supplies a Y and X offset per sprite; sprites that wrap off screen are hidden. The attribute is XORed with the facing flip and ORed with the priority bit (ObjFlags bit 5).

editorial_audit.notes: Round 3 final editorial review (checkpoint pass-003, 262160/262160 bytes classified). Scope: carried round-2 review credit (all 1031 entries were reviewed in round 2; source regenerated from the same notes) plus every changed or concretely inconsistent item; no whole-source reread. Findings and fixes: (1) $F62C stale 'unknown' note replaced by the PlayerBump_DeadRts explanation (static code, reachability not claimed). (2) L-016 Static->Observed provenance: inline markers follow the pass-003 headers; no prose claimed those routines unexecuted. (3) All 28 raw base-offset operands resolved (MetaspritePtrLo/Hi, MultiplesOf7, NotePeriods+1, DirectionVelocityTable, Boss51WaveDropX, Metatile* level-bank constants, ResetStub_BankN+1, SpawnEnteringObjects bank-4 call). (4) Stale numeric aliases: ~480 raw RAM operands replaced by names (array sizes, sound channel fields, sound zero page); none remain in instructions. (5) Misleading field names: PlayerThrow_Launch/CheckEnd and ObjType64 used plain Obj* names with Y = PlayerCarry|$80; now Obj*-$80. (6) Contradictory/wrong names and text: EnvelopeSustain (actually the shared output tail) -> ChannelOutput; WriteChannelVolume -> WriteChannelReg; ChannelSet0714/ChannelSetSweep -> ChannelSetDetune/ChannelSetSlideRate; effect 'volume' field -> gate ratio; EnvelopePhaseTable order corrected. (7) Weak automatic branch labels in the densest clusters named (ChannelOutput 28, UpdateCameraX 21, ObjType00, Platform_TwoPlayers, NmiPpuUpdate); ~260 parent-anchored _SkipN/_LoopN labels remain as acceptable local branch names. (8) No duplicate stacked comments found; remaining semantic uncertainties are stated tentatively in source and listed in uncertainties.md (object/item identities, sound command audible meaning, packed period format, HUD second counter, PlayerConfig pause byte, 8-byte bank trailer).
